title: Spelling disambiguation
goal: Every spelling rule: when a sound takes different keys because of how the word is written, with the keys and an example word for each.

blocks.x: Spelling picks between ways to write a sound. A spelling rule looks at the whole word, its start, its end, the sound before, or a prefix on an unstressed first vowel. When one fits, the sound becomes a named variant (`UW.oo`) with its own keys. Every choice is one line in `rules/plover.toml`, and `!explain` shows which fired.

Examples: `UW` is [[AO]] in *moon* but [[AOU]] in *tune*; `T` is [[-D]] in *walked*; `!ou` is the plain [[U]] in *rough* where `o` is [[O]] in *love*; `be-` is [[E]] in *believe*, `a-` is [[A]] in *about*.

items: The first rule for a sound whose condition fits wins. The tables below are in that order for each sound.
**the word contains / starts / ends**: the letters are in the spelling. "Starts" and "ends" also require the sound to be the first or last sound of the word.
**prefix**: the sound is the word's first vowel, it is unstressed, and the word starts with those letters (`be-` in *believe*, not in *bee*).
**after / before**: the sound before, or the final sound after.
**not**: none of the listed letters may be in the word.
**two or more syllables**: a one-syllable word never uses the rule.

**only when another word would take the same stroke**: used only to tell sound-alike words apart. The word is written this way when another word would otherwise have the same outline. Which of the two words gets the shorter form falls out of the solve described in [when two words sound the same](#/ref/collisions).

blocks.x: Vowel and R pairs the spelling changes
These variants combine with a following R (or `!ng`) in [vowel + R](#/ref/phonetic-rules): [[AR]] for `war`, [[UR]] for `sure`, [[AER]] for `dear`, `hear`, `stare`, `their`, and [[ER]] for `berry`.
Joined strokes spell the long vowel plainly

In joined strokes only (never in a primary outline) a long `o` written with the plain letter also gets the plain keys: `control` is [[control|KOPB/+TROL]] as well as [[control|KOPB/+TROEL]]. The rule: sound `OW`, word contains `o` and none of `oa`, `!ow`, `!oe`, `!ou`, `!oo`, `!oi`, `ough`.

Words that sound the same are told apart by this: [[sail|SAEUL]] and [[sale|SAEL]], [[dear|TKAER]] and [[deer|TKAOER]], [[stair|STAEUR]] and [[stare|STAER]], [[load|HROD]] and [[lode|HROED]], [[write|WREU]] and [[right|ROEUT]]. Pairs that spell the same pattern get a star instead: see [when two words sound the same](#/ref/collisions).
